title: MERGE: update, insert and delete in one step
objectives: Say what each MERGE clause does: matched, not matched, and deletes
Work out the table a MERGE leaves behind before running it
Know why the source needs one row per key

exercises.prompt: Write the SELECT that returns customers as the MERGE in the lesson would leave it: customer_id, name and city, smallest customer_id first.
hints: A FULL OUTER JOIN of customers and changes on customer_id gives every key from both sides, matched or not.
Where a change matched, its name and city win. Where none did, the customer keeps its own.
Leave out the keys whose change is a delete. A delete for a customer that isn't there does nothing.
